primary_endpoint: Safety endpoints through 20 weeks and change/percent change in liver fat by MRI-PDFF at week 12.
efficacy_outcome: At week 12, MRI-PDFF liver fat percent change was −18.02% with FT-4101 3.0 mg versus +25.98% with placebo; absolute change was −3.65 versus +4.16 percentage points. No statistical significance is reported.
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 3 participants in each group; clinically significant laboratory and physical examination changes occurred in 0 participants in each group. No serious AEs or deaths were reported (FT-4101 0/9; placebo 0/5).
